features.quote: Classes with Arnaud DJBN, Ichigo, Manu & Olivia
features.rationale: The event lists dance classes taught by named teachers.
Daytime socials are scheduled in the afternoon.
The event has three dance rooms.
A dress code theme is explicitly stated.

features.quote: Saturday: campus chill (social) & night of the prom (party)
features.rationale: Party nights are built around dress themes such as the night of the prom.
The full pass price bundles accommodation.
Breakfasts are included with the accommodation package.

features.quote: Shuttles will be provided for festival-goers arriving by train or plane on Friday and Sunday.
features.rationale: Shuttles are provided to and from train and plane arrivals.
